tool_schemas.name: search
tool_schemas.description: Executes a Google search for the authenticated client using the provided query and options (limit, timeout, language, region), returning up to limit normalized result items; the request and returned items are recorded for audit/caching/analytics and may be served from cache when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is missing/empty, if limit or timeout are not numbers or are out of allowed bounds, or if language/region are not accepted values; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid and FORBIDDEN if the key is not permitted for the workspace. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the API key/workspace has exhausted its search quota and TIMEOUT when the search does not complete within the specified timeout.

limit.description: 返回的搜索结果数量，默认为10

timeout.description: 搜索操作的超时时间(毫秒)，默认为60000

language.description: 搜索结果的语言，例如 zh-CN, en-US 等，默认为 zh-CN

region.description: 搜索结果的地区，例如 cn, com, co.jp 等，默认为 cn

tool_schemas.name: list_search_queries
tool_schemas.description: Lists recorded search query runs for the authenticated API key's workspace, newest first, with optional filtering by status, time range, and cache usage; refuses INVALID_ARGUMENT on invalid filters and UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid/revoked.

status.description: Filter by search query lifecycle status.

served_from_cache.description: If set, only return queries that were (true) or were not (false) served from cache.

created_after.description: Only include queries created at or after this RFC3339 timestamp.

created_before.description: Only include queries created at or before this RFC3339 timestamp.

page_size.description: Maximum number of items to return per page (default 50).

page_token.description: Opaque pagination token returned by a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: get_search_query
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single recorded search query by id (including execution metadata and cache fields) for the authenticated API key's workspace; refuses NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist in the workspace and UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid/revoked.

tool_schemas.name: list_search_results
tool_schemas.description: Lists normalized result items for a recorded search query, ordered by rank ascending; refuses NOT_FOUND if the search_query_id does not exist in the workspace and UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid/revoked.

page_size.description: Maximum number of items to return per page (default 100).

page_token.description: Opaque pagination token returned by a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_search_query
tool_schemas.description: Cancels a queued or running search query owned by the authenticated API key's workspace by transitioning its status to cancelled; refuses FAILED_PRECONDITION if the query is already in a terminal state, and NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist in the workspace.

reason.description: Optional human-readable cancellation reason for audit logs.

tool_schemas.name: get_usage_bucket
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current month's usage counters (requests/results/timeouts/failures) for the authenticated API key within its workspace, used for quota visibility; refuses UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid/revoked.

period_start.description: Optional period start date (YYYY-MM-01). If omitted, uses the current month in service timezone.

metadata.name: Google Search
metadata.description: This backend stores authenticated client access to a Google-search proxy API, including API keys, per-request search queries, and the returned result items for audit, caching, and analytics.
